authority: Cross-system journeys are acceptance contracts over existing leaves. They make hand-offs, permissions, drafts, failures, customer-visible outcomes and evidence explicit without changing any leaf status or creating a production claim from kit behaviour. Each journey states the relevant release-profile boundary: designed capability, capability enabled for the cohort, and independent runtime proof remain distinct.

journeys.title: Phone source with seven product lines to reviewed unvalued albaran draft
journeys.actualRuntimeGap: A source view, parsed candidate or local draft is not an accepted line, SKU creation, issued albaran, customer message, stock movement or ERP action. In the order-review profile, a seven-line result remains unvalued and every enabled review command needs its own tenant-scoped actual evidence.

steps.action: Retain the seven phone-source lines with source identity, wording, position and revision.
steps.permissions: Source-read and source-retention policy for the current tenant.
steps.draft: The source review is reopenable; it creates no SKU, receipt, stock movement, priced document, customer message or ERP action.
steps.failure: Unavailable, quarantined or incomplete source names the actual retained count and recovery path.
steps.customerOutcome: No customer-visible change or completion claim.
steps.evidence: Synthetic seven-line fixture with source lineage and retention decision trace.

steps.action: Resolve each line as an exact tenant SKU, a field-check on an otherwise exact SKU, an off-SKU literal item, or a choice between multiple real SKUs.
steps.permissions: Catalogue/product proposal authority is distinct from source read authority.
steps.draft: Candidate, field-check reason, literal off-SKU row and multiple-choice selection remain draft until a named review command succeeds.
steps.failure: Ambiguous/missing match retains wording and offers the required review state; similar name/model output cannot select a SKU or manufacture a top candidate.
steps.customerOutcome: No invented product name, code, price, total, stock or availability claim.
steps.evidence: Exact-match, ambiguity and unknown-product replay report.

steps.action: Keep a repeated preparation/brochure wording as a note or proposed option unless a reviewer separately enters the new-SKU/variation flow.
steps.permissions: Tenant policy and manual reviewed creation grant are required for a new sellable SKU or mapped variation; accepting an off-SKU line is not that grant.
steps.draft: Base-item note, off-SKU one-off and proposed variation remain reviewable with source lineage.
steps.failure: suggestNewSkus=false blocks automatic SKU hardening; a missing mapping retains the literal one-off or note.
steps.customerOutcome: The accepted line treatment is visible before an unvalued document draft; no customer reply is sent by Rocoto.
steps.evidence: Repeated-wording fixture proving no automatic SKU/ERP mapping.

steps.action: Review the active line grammar: normal exact line; a red local outline/underline around only the ambiguous or abnormal field; a faded italic literal off-SKU one-off with accept/reject; or a compact multiple-exact-SKU choice.
steps.permissions: Order-review command authority for the exact tenant and current source/order revision.
steps.draft: A field check, one-off acceptance/rejection and multiple-choice selection remain draft until review accepts them; no lot, inventory or tariff state is created.
steps.failure: Negative or unsupported quantity/unit, stale source, rejected one-off or unresolved choice remains repairable and moves no stock.
steps.customerOutcome: No availability, received-goods, price, total or customer-message claim before acceptance.
steps.evidence: Exact/field-check/off-SKU/multiple-choice matrix with source spans, duplicate-retry and mobile traces.

steps.action: Review and accept only the selected unvalued line-level acts with idempotency and source lineage; separately show any reasoned reply-attention that is unrelated to a line identity.
steps.permissions: Each order-review, product-creation and future document command checks its own grant and expected revision; native chat/email handoff checks no outbound grant because it does not send.
steps.draft: Unaccepted rows and reply-attention items remain separated from accepted rows and can be reopened or dismissed with a custom reason.
steps.failure: Partial success lists accepted identifiers and unresolved rows; it never says all seven received, priced, sent or final without the separately enabled commands and evidence.
steps.customerOutcome: Only later, separately enabled customer/document outcomes can be shown; the active reply tray opens the relevant native provider thread.
steps.evidence: Command/event lineage report across seven rows.

steps.action: Keep an off-SKU product with box/kg wording as a faded italic literal source row until a reviewer accepts it as a one-off, rejects it, or selects one exact SKU from a multiple-choice set.
steps.permissions: Source read and order-review authority are required; a later new-SKU command has separate creation authority.
steps.draft: Preserve literal product wording, stated box/kg facts, candidates and validation gaps; never derive a conversion, inventory quantity or top candidate by default.
steps.failure: Unknown identity, unsupported unit or missing equivalence blocks a choice/acceptance and keeps the row repairable; no generic reply flag replaces this line state.
steps.customerOutcome: No invented SKU, conversion, availability, stock, price, total or customer message is shown.
steps.evidence: Off-SKU/box-kg accept/reject and multiple-real-SKU fixture with no-auto-SKU/no-fake-candidate proof.

steps.action: Recover an interrupted seven-line review by reopening its tenant-scoped draft and refetching current source/target revisions before a new command.
steps.permissions: The same scoped source/target read permissions are checked on reopen; each later write checks its own current grant.
steps.draft: Persist only draft intent, lineage, per-row state and idempotency identity; separate previously accepted rows from unresolved rows.
steps.failure: A changed revision, expired authority or uncertain prior outcome requires review and cannot force-apply the draft.
steps.customerOutcome: Recovery never claims all seven reviewed, received, priced, communicated or final merely because a draft reopens.
steps.evidence: Interrupted-entry/reopen, stale-revision, tenant-isolation and no-duplicate-command traces.

positive: Seven retained source rows remain individually traceable through review and any accepted unvalued line/document action.
Repeated options follow tenant policy and manual review before becoming a sellable SKU or mapped variation; one-off acceptance does not create one.
Exact, field-check, off-SKU and multiple-choice rows plus interrupted drafts preserve literal lineage until independently reviewed, current-revision commands are accepted.
An unrelated uncertainty appears as an independent reasoned reply-attention with custom dismissal and native-provider handoff, not as a fake line state or a customer send.
negative: A repeated phrase, similar SKU name, model proposal, one-off acceptance or local draft cannot auto-create stock, a SKU, an ERP mapping or customer message.
A partial batch cannot display as seven accepted, priced, sent or final lines.
An interrupted draft, unknown product or ambiguous box/kg wording cannot infer a conversion, issue stock, fabricate a top candidate or report seven completed rows.
A no-match route, save-next sequence or later item cannot prefill/create a SKU, inherit a lot, send a reply or masquerade as a bulk stock event.

requiredEvidence: Seven-line unvalued order-review fixture, source-to-command lineage, capability matrix, negative-path trace and mobile/accessibility evidence.
Exact/field-check/off-SKU/multiple-choice plus interrupted-draft recovery fixtures with current-revision, no-auto-SKU, no-fake-candidate and no-outbound proof.
Reasoned reply-attention custom-dismissal/native-provider-handoff fixture with no-send proof.

journeys.title: Working paper to actual kg/price review and final albaran
journeys.actualRuntimeGap: This is a full-production commercial/inventory journey and is disabled in the order-review profile. A print preview/request, handwritten value, image extraction or local photo review does not prove physical print, accepted actuals, final document issue, provider receipt or customer delivery; no price, total or lot field may surface in order review as though this journey were enabled.

steps.action: Render a working-paper snapshot with revision, scope and explicit unknown-final-fact treatment.
steps.permissions: Document read/render authority and selected print profile access.
steps.draft: Working paper is an output snapshot; it does not finalise commercial facts.
steps.failure: Render/print failure preserves the selected revision and names output state without physical-print claim.
steps.customerOutcome: No final total or final document claim when actual facts remain unknown.
steps.evidence: Immutable snapshot comparison and print-state trace.

steps.action: Capture actual quantity/kg and final-price proposals manually or from a photographed paper.
steps.permissions: Media retention/review authority is separate from commercial/document write authority.
steps.draft: Photo/manual values are proposals linked to paper/document/revision evidence.
steps.failure: Unreadable, duplicate, stale or uncertain evidence stays review-required and cannot write a line.
steps.customerOutcome: No fabricated kg, price or total.
steps.evidence: Synthetic annotated-paper/photo fixture with source coordinates and uncertainty states.

steps.action: Review line before/after values, units, price basis, lot consequences and concerns against the latest revision.
steps.permissions: Commercial/document amendment grant with expected revision and concern-scope authority.
steps.draft: Review preserves proposals and concerns until a named correction/resolution command is accepted.
steps.failure: Conflict, unit mismatch, missing price authority or unresolved concern retains the draft and blocks issue.
steps.customerOutcome: Prior accepted revision remains authoritative.
steps.evidence: Stale-paper, unit-mismatch, concern-dismissal and recovery traces.

steps.action: Accept reviewed actuals as a linked amendment and render an immutable final albaran revision.
steps.permissions: Server checks document, commercial, stock/lot and issue policies at the command.
steps.draft: Previous working paper/revision remains inspectable and stale where applicable.
steps.failure: Denied/failed amendment does not overwrite prior facts or fabricate a new revision.
steps.customerOutcome: Customer view uses only accepted frozen values and its own price-visibility policy.
steps.evidence: Capture-to-amendment-to-revision lineage and immutable output checksum.

steps.action: Issue/reprint/output the selected revision with independent document and transport states.
steps.permissions: Issue/reprint/transport grants are checked independently of amendment review.
steps.draft: Accepted document revision persists even if a later output job fails.
steps.failure: Queued, failed, cancelled, retried and unknown output remain distinct from issued revision.
steps.customerOutcome: Prices are shown or hidden according to the stored document policy, with no false print/delivery claim.
steps.evidence: Two policy-render comparisons and provider/output receipt trace.

steps.action: Review an actual partial delivery against named lot allocations and accept only delivered/depleted quantity while retaining the unfulfilled balance.
steps.permissions: Stock/lot and document amendment authority are checked independently at the current document and lot revisions.
steps.draft: Keep named lot assignments, assigned/unassigned balance and proposed document revision together as a recoverable draft.
steps.failure: Lot conflict, over-allocation or missing delivery evidence blocks the amendment; remaining quantity is not assumed delivered.
steps.customerOutcome: The final document states only accepted partial delivery and never silently completes the remainder.
steps.evidence: Partial-delivery multi-lot fixture, invariant/conflict trace and final-document comparison.

steps.action: Propose an exact substitution with its unit/price consequence and collect separately evidenced customer approval before final issue.
steps.permissions: Proposal authority, customer-contact authorization and final document issue authority remain separate commands.
steps.draft: Keep proposed substitute, source reason, approval request/receipt, expiry and document revision separately recoverable.
steps.failure: Pending, denied, expired or stale approval blocks final substitution and leaves the previous accepted line authoritative.
steps.customerOutcome: No substitute is presented as accepted, delivered or final before its matching customer-approval and document-revision evidence.
steps.evidence: Substitution proposal/approval/expiry/revision-conflict fixture and no-final-issue denial trace.

steps.action: Run the paper-review/photo intake as a revision-bound human comparison: retain current/working/stale/final state, optional local source photo, manual actual fields and explicit Finish review.
steps.permissions: Paper source attach/read, line correction and later print each require their own current tenant/document/print scope authority.
steps.draft: Photo retry/local association and manual actual field drafts remain distinct from an accepted line amendment and later print snapshot.
steps.failure: Missing/failed photo, stale review, invalid actual or omitted finish cannot apply figures, mark final, issue a document or claim physical print.
steps.customerOutcome: A customer sees only a later accepted document revision under its policy; no photo, review state or working-paper label claims delivery.
steps.evidence: Paper stage/photo-retry/manual-field/Finish-review/later-print fixture with no-auto-extraction and no-final-without-later-print proof.

positive: Actual kg/price reaches a final albaran only through evidenced human review, accepted amendment and immutable revision.
Customer price visibility is explicit before issue and is stored with the document policy snapshot.
Partial delivery remains attributed to named lots and a substitution reaches final issue only after separately evidenced customer approval.
Paper review reaches final paper only through matched source/document review, explicit Finish review and a later canonical print.
negative: Photo/OCR extraction, a working print, dismissal or a preview cannot directly finalise a line or resolve a concern.
A print request cannot claim physical print, customer delivery or final commercial facts.
A remaining lot balance or proposed substitute cannot be silently completed, allocated or shown as accepted delivery.
A local photo, missing blob, automatic reading proposal, omission of completion or old print cannot apply figures or make paper final.

requiredEvidence: Paper/photo review fixture, amendment lineage, concern test, output-state trace and two customer-document policy renders.
Partial-lot-delivery and substitution approval/expiry fixtures with no-final-issue denial proof.
Paper stage/source-photo/manual-actual/finish/later-print fixture with client-retention failure and no-final shortcut proof.

journeys.title: Four SKU price changes and truthful in-chat confirmation
journeys.actualRuntimeGap: This is a full-production commercial/customer-outbound journey and is disabled in the order-review profile. A four-row price draft, client-side preview, setting control or queued transport attempt does not prove accepted prices, message provider acceptance, customer receipt or document issue; dormant controls must not appear as live capability.

steps.action: Build a four-exact-SKU tariff price draft with previous value, proposed value, unit, effective time and reason/source.
steps.permissions: Tenant commercial-write grant for each exact SKU/tariff scope.
steps.draft: All rows remain draft until server acceptance; a family relation cannot apply a price to another SKU.
steps.failure: Invalid/stale/retired row remains named with repair copy and cannot hide behind a batch-success message.
steps.customerOutcome: No customer message or document price changes from a draft.
steps.evidence: Four-SKU fixture with stale, retired-tariff and unit-policy negatives.

steps.action: Validate and accept the price command under effective commercial policy with per-row or atomic truth.
steps.permissions: Server checks commercial policy, revision, exact decimal, tariff lifecycle and idempotency.
steps.draft: Unaccepted rows remain retryable/reviewable; issued document snapshots remain unchanged.
steps.failure: Partial/denied command reports exact accepted and rejected rows without invented price acceptance.
steps.customerOutcome: Only accepted price values are eligible for a later confirmation or document.
steps.evidence: Accepted event trace, decimal calculation evidence and retry/idempotency report.

steps.action: Show all three quote settings, chosen-account live price preview and customer-visible consequence before requesting a message.
steps.permissions: Read effective grants/configuration; message request needs separate channel/recipient authorization.
steps.draft: Preview uses exact current four-SKU scope, chosen account and stored effective policy, never stale browser/seeded data.
steps.failure: Disabled/missing control, unavailable price or settings-write failure preserves prior setting state and names the quote/repair boundary.
steps.customerOutcome: Only all three enabled controls allow a quote; the preview says Price to confirm and Order is not fully confirmed when value evidence is missing.
steps.evidence: All grants.confirm/config.confirmation.includePrices/config.albaran.values matrix snapshots plus settings-save-failure trace.

steps.action: Request an authorized in-chat confirmation; require all three settings for a price quote.
steps.permissions: Live outbound grant, approved recipient/channel, tenant policy and message scope check.
steps.draft: Message request records exact price-inclusion choice and accepted SKU scope separately from price command.
steps.failure: Disabled transport, one disabled quote control, provider failure or revoked grant preserves price acceptance but creates no sent/delivered claim.
steps.customerOutcome: A quote includes prices only when all three settings permit; internal ERP price remains unaffected by customer presentation settings.
steps.evidence: No-outbound transport, provider submission/receipt/failure/retry trace.

steps.action: Prepare any later albaran independently with accepted line price and config.albaran.values policy snapshot.
steps.permissions: Document issue/read policy is independent of chat permission.
steps.draft: Albaran preview is a document draft/revision, not a chat copy.
steps.failure: Document policy mismatch or issue denial blocks only document outcome and preserves prior accepted facts.
steps.customerOutcome: Quote visibility never overrides albaran policy; hiding customer values never erases internal commercial/ERP price facts.
steps.evidence: Customer-document comparisons for both visibility values and issue permission trace.

steps.action: Keep a recurring brochure or preparation request as a note until explicit review accepts a separately approved customerOption snapshot or mapped variation.
steps.permissions: Product-option review, product adoption and ERP mapping authority are separate from the confirmation settings controls.
steps.draft: Retain source wording, internal preparation note, customerOption proposal, approval/mapping state and base SKU separately.
steps.failure: Recurrence, a UI setting or missing approval/mapping cannot create a SKU or copy an internal note to customer output.
steps.customerOutcome: The customer sees an approved base-item/customer-option or variation distinction before issue, never an auto-created SKU.
steps.evidence: Recurring-option fixture with no-auto-SKU, approved customerOption and customer-document distinction traces.

steps.action: Open a new commercial review when a daily rate changes after a quote snapshot was accepted, preserving the prior quote as historic evidence.
steps.permissions: Commercial approval and any new message request each check current tenant policy, recipient and exact SKU scope.
steps.draft: Keep original quote snapshot, later price proposal, effective time and review outcome separately; never rewrite the accepted message body.
steps.failure: A stale/new rate cannot be silently substituted into an accepted quote or issued document; it stays pending review.
steps.customerOutcome: A customer receives a new-price review only where authorized; the earlier accepted quote stays truthful.
steps.evidence: Quote-snapshot/later-rate fixture, no-rewrite regression and approved re-quote trace.

steps.action: Block an ERP adapter request when the approved customerOption, mapped variation or surcharge has no reviewed destination representation.
steps.permissions: ERP adapter authorization and mapping approval are checked independently of customer preview and price settings.
steps.draft: Retain option/surcharge representation, selected policy and mapping problem as a recoverable draft without a sync claim.
steps.failure: Missing destination support cannot silently drop, flatten, create or substitute an ERP line.
steps.customerOutcome: No customer or ERP success outcome appears until a permitted reviewed representation is accepted.
steps.evidence: Missing-option/surcharge mapping fixture, blocked adapter request and reviewed-representation receipt trace.

steps.action: Review a Team note separately from a proposed product option and explicitly approve only an eligible customerOption snapshot for outward copy.
steps.permissions: Order-note review, customer-option approval, product creation, document issue and message/ERP composition all check distinct current grants and scope.
steps.draft: Keep literal team note, recurrence fact, reusable-name draft, customer-visible text draft, approval/source/actor/time and product candidate separately revisioned.
steps.failure: Recurrence, a raw note, unapproved audience, local review failure or cancel cannot create a SKU, pass text outward, alter price/stock or rewrite issued/sent snapshots.
steps.customerOutcome: Only an approved customerOption appears in customer confirmation/paper; internal preparation text remains internal.
steps.evidence: Team-note/product-option/customerOption approve-remove/outward-filter fixture with no-auto-SKU and no-prepNote-leak proof.

positive: All four price changes retain exact SKU/tariff/unit identity, accepted policy revision and separate message/document consequences.
The operator and customer outcome preview disclose chat versus albaran price treatment before either request.
An approved customerOption/mapped-variation and a later re-quote retain distinct approval, price/policy snapshot and ERP representation evidence.
A customer-facing option is an explicit approved snapshot with audience/review/source/actor/time and remains distinct from its internal Team note.
negative: A setting, queued attempt or provider submission cannot claim customer receipt/delivery or rewrite issued document prices.
A price included in chat cannot silently force a price into a hidden-price albaran.
Recurrence, an internal preparation note, a later daily rate or a missing ERP field cannot rewrite an accepted quote, auto-create a SKU or silently flatten an option/surcharge.
A prepNote, raw request, recurrence or unapproved option cannot appear in customer confirmation, customer paper or ERP composition.

requiredEvidence: Four-SKU matrix fixture, policy snapshots, price-event trace, outbound transport evidence and customer-document comparisons.
CustomerOption/ERP-representation, later-rate re-quote and no-auto-SKU fixtures with blocked-mapping proof.
Team-note/customerOption approval-removal/outward-filter fixture with no-prepNote-leak and independent product-create proof.

journeys.title: New SKU to price, customer quote, albarán edit and reprint
journeys.actualRuntimeGap: The order-review profile enables literal SKU creation/review, reviewed artwork and unvalued print/file output, while price, quote and customer delivery are disabled. The kit's CreateSKU, local price handoff, artwork request, quote preview and native-print request do not prove server-authorized SKU/price/document acceptance, customer delivery, physical print or local-file persistence.

steps.action: Create a tenant-scoped manual SKU from Product name, SKU and Unit, or create a variation SKU from a literal difference description.
steps.permissions: Product-create authority; SKU and Selling-unit data policy are checked at command time.
steps.draft: Typing, cancel, Back and Upload catalogue preserve scoped identity draft and create no product.
steps.failure: Blank Product name, SKU or Unit retains the draft. Canonical SKU storage trims outer whitespace, compares case-insensitively, preserves internal punctuation and leading zeroes, and blocks duplicates with repair/Open existing.
steps.customerOutcome: No sellable identity, price or customer consequence.
steps.evidence: Exact-SKU/blank-Sold-by/outer-whitespace/case-insensitive-duplicate/custom-unit/variation fixtures at desktop, 390 and 320 px.

steps.action: Commit one stable SKU with idempotent recovery across SKU and catalogue stores.
steps.permissions: Tenant/create policy, current revision and request identity.
steps.draft: Partial write retains one creation identity; retry resumes it.
steps.failure: Dependent-store failure cannot create another SKU, artwork or price event.
steps.customerOutcome: No success claim before both identity stores accept.
steps.evidence: Injected second-store failure and same-ID retry lineage.

steps.action: Write first exact-SKU Price and review a selected customer quote.
steps.permissions: Commercial tariff write and separate recipient/channel/message authority.
steps.draft: Price and quote drafts retain exact SKU/tariff/customer/policy snapshots.
steps.failure: Conflict, missing price, policy denial or provider failure keeps accepted facts separate from unsent request.
steps.customerOutcome: No quote/sent/delivered claim without provider receipt.
steps.evidence: Price revision, policy matrix and provider-state trace.

steps.action: Create/edit an albarán and output/reprint a selected document revision.
steps.permissions: Independent document amendment, issue, output and physical-confirmation grants.
steps.draft: Stale document amendment and output request retain selected revision/context.
steps.failure: Stale revision, downloadStarted or print requested cannot claim local save or physical print.
steps.customerOutcome: Only issued revision/policy snapshot is customer-visible; printed requires explicit Confirm printed.
steps.evidence: Historic-snapshot, stale-reprint, requested/Confirm printed/downloadStarted matrix.

steps.action: Open the captured copy, request native printing and explicitly confirm the actual version/copies; later edits show Changed since printing.
steps.permissions: Document render/print and confirmation authority, separately from issue or outbound send.
steps.draft: Retain the original request ID and frozen copy on popup failure; unresolved print stays unconfirmed.
steps.failure: A canceled dialog, download request, old revision or asset failure never confirms current paper.
steps.customerOutcome: Customer sees only the deliberately issued copy; no new email, invoice or repricing from Print.
steps.evidence: Native dialog invocation, blocked retry, stale-version confirmation, person/time activity and reprint-count trace.

positive: Canonical SKU value, first price, quote and document revisions remain exact-SKU scoped.
Retry and reprint preserve one request/revision lineage.
negative: No default kg/category/family assignment, duplicate sibling, historical repricing, delivery claim, local-save claim or physical-print claim.

requiredEvidence: Exact identity/retry/price/quote/albarán/reprint lineage with desktop and phone interruption evidence.

journeys.title: Operator-reported shortage to reviewed impact, customer copy and partial/unknown delivery
journeys.actualRuntimeGap: This is a full-production inventory/supply-impact/customer-outbound journey and is disabled in the order-review profile. An operator report, local impact view or generated copy does not prove supplier confirmation, customer contact, delivery, shortage acceptance or stock/document amendment; native handoff never becomes a customer send.

steps.action: Record exact-SKU/lot shortage facts and explicit unknowns as a scoped draft.
steps.permissions: Shortage-report authority for tenant/location.
steps.draft: Unknown quantity/delivery remains explicit and recoverable.
steps.failure: Missing fact blocks only dependent command; no default delivery conclusion.
steps.customerOutcome: No customer claim.
steps.evidence: Known/unknown shortage fixture.

steps.action: Review exact-SKU commitment, lot and document impact.
steps.permissions: Read authority for current stock/commitment/document scope.
steps.draft: Treatment proposal remains distinct from impact projection.
steps.failure: Changed revision requires re-review.
steps.customerOutcome: No stale-impact contact.
steps.evidence: Lot/document conflict trace.

steps.action: Review evidence-bounded copy and authorized recipients, then request communication separately.
steps.permissions: Recipient/channel consent and message command authority.
steps.draft: Copy revision, recipients and policy snapshot remain scoped.
steps.failure: Per-recipient/provider states remain separate.
steps.customerOutcome: No dispatch/delivery/supplier-confirmed claim without evidence.
steps.evidence: Mixed-recipient policy/provider matrix.

steps.action: Accept partial or unknown delivery evidence with remainder and lot/document amendments.
steps.permissions: Independent stock/lot/document authority at current revisions.
steps.draft: Partial/remainder/unknown follow-up remains recoverable.
steps.failure: Over-delivery/unit/lot conflict blocks acceptance.
steps.customerOutcome: Only accepted partial quantity is shown; unknown stays unknown.
steps.evidence: Partial/unknown delivery and interruption fixtures.

steps.action: Reconcile outbound outcomes per exact approved recipient and recover known retryable failures without sending again to accepted or unknown recipients.
steps.permissions: Verified current channel authority, consent and signed approval digest/recipient set.
steps.draft: Retain exact message, recipient and order/evidence revisions through timeout or partial receipt.
steps.failure: Unknown, malformed or incomplete receipt blocks blind retry until idempotent status lookup.
steps.customerOutcome: Only provider evidence supports Sent or Delivered; no double message after a timeout.
steps.evidence: Partial receipt, accepted/failed/unknown disjoint-set checks, stale approval and reconciliation trace.

positive: Exact-SKU shortage impact, recipient copy and partial delivery retain evidence and revisions.
negative: Operator report cannot imply supplier confirmation, customer send, complete delivery or substitute acceptance.

requiredEvidence: Impact/copy/recipient/partial-unknown delivery traces at desktop, 390 and 320 px.

journeys.title: Template gallery to configured copy, scoped output and history
journeys.actualRuntimeGap: A gallery card, builder draft, local preview or downloadStarted event does not prove a durable recipe, completed file, local save, recipient access, ERP import or history retention.

steps.action: Browse tenant-permitted templates and build exact schema-backed columns.
steps.permissions: Export/read and sensitive-column policy.
steps.draft: Template/column selection is local until save.
steps.failure: Denied/stale/cross-tenant field remains named and invalid.
steps.customerOutcome: No file/data claim.
steps.evidence: Tenant/column-denial fixture.

steps.action: Save immutable tenant-scoped recipe revision.
steps.permissions: Recipe save authority and expected revision.
steps.draft: Conflict retains latest and draft versions separately.
steps.failure: No in-place overwrite of historical recipes/files.
steps.customerOutcome: No export claim.
steps.evidence: Conflict/save-as-new trace.

steps.action: Request scoped file and retain run/recipe/source/policy evidence in history.
steps.permissions: Export run authority for current source scope.
steps.draft: Requested run and recipe remain distinct from finished file.
steps.failure: Requested/queued/partial/stale/expired states are explicit; retry re-reviews scope.
steps.customerOutcome: Download started never claims a local save or recipient access.
steps.evidence: Run-state/file-manifest/downloadStarted negative matrix.

steps.action: Recover builder/history across desktop and phone interruption.
steps.permissions: Current schema/policy rechecked on reopen.
steps.draft: Intent restores without implicit save/run.
steps.failure: Policy/schema change blocks stale action but preserves draft for repair.
steps.customerOutcome: No updated/current-file claim from stale bytes.
steps.evidence: Reload/offline/390/320 focus and no-overflow evidence.

steps.action: Use each column chevron to change its source field, rename the heading and move it by drag or keyboard before generating the same mapped file.
steps.permissions: Authorised recipe fields and export data at current tenant/schema revision.
steps.draft: Column stable IDs, order and headings remain a draft until explicit Save template.
steps.failure: Retired/private field or failed save retains the draft and blocks incorrect generation.
steps.customerOutcome: No file includes a mismatched heading/value, private field, unsafe formula or stale schema.
steps.evidence: Drag/keyboard equivalence, schema-change and generated workbook content parity fixture.

positive: Recipe, column, source cutoff, file run and history revision remain separately auditable.
negative: A label, preview, downloadStarted or stale recipe cannot create a completed file/local-save/recipient-access claim.

journeys.title: First-time setup to controlled activation
journeys.actualRuntimeGap: A guided setup screen, local answer, selected phone number, upload preview, manual browser mark or roleplay turn is not a provisioned tenant, verified provider connection, accepted intake, analysis run, customer message or production activation.

steps.action: Open and resume the setup journey in the shared 800×600 task frame.
steps.permissions: Authenticated tenant owner/session and current activation read scope.
steps.draft: Only tenant-scoped permitted setup drafts and current unanswered fact restore.
steps.failure: Close, reload, offline or changed role preserves safe draft and names recovery; no replayed external act.
steps.customerOutcome: No activation, connection or customer message claim.
steps.evidence: 1920×1080, 1536×864, 1366×768, 360×800, 390×844 and 393×873, plus 1280×800 and 320×740 boundary frame/body-scroll/focus/keyboard recovery trace.

steps.action: Answer organisation and policy questions one at a time with current revisions.
steps.permissions: Owner or delegated organisation-setting authority.
steps.draft: Each labelled answer remains a draft until accepted; prior accepted answers stay separate.
steps.failure: Invalid or stale answer identifies the field/revision and refetches before save.
steps.customerOutcome: No policy, delivery or activation consequence from an unfinished answer.
steps.evidence: One-question ordering, validation, Back/Close/reopen and stale-setting fixture.

steps.action: Connect one named salesperson WhatsApp line and keep its owner distinct from later lines.
steps.permissions: Connection-owner and team-assignment authority; provider authorisation is separate.
steps.draft: Number/owner proposal remains pending until authorised connection and assignment acceptance.
steps.failure: Unverified, revoked or conflicting line stays unavailable and retains no wider account scope.
steps.customerOutcome: No message or live-connection claim.
steps.evidence: Two-line/independent-owner/revoke/no-send provider-boundary fixture.

steps.action: Submit authorised delivery-note, product and customer intake and review accepted facts.
steps.permissions: Source upload/read/review authority with tenant retention policy.
steps.draft: Source reference, validation and unresolved rows restore without raw-file leakage into conversation history.
steps.failure: Unsupported, quarantined, denied or interrupted source offers explicit retry/reselect/review recovery.
steps.customerOutcome: No sellable SKU, stock, import-complete or analysis-complete claim.
steps.evidence: Source-scope/retention/quarantine/reload fixture.

steps.action: State unavailable analysis honestly, record manual review explicitly, then run controlled roleplay and activation-gate review.
steps.permissions: Manual review, controlled roleplay and activation decision each require their own current authority.
steps.draft: Checklist retains accepted facts and unresolved gates, never a simulated provider/model result.
steps.failure: Roleplay, connection-test, legal/billing or owner-acceptance denial blocks activation and preserves the checklist.
steps.customerOutcome: No customer contact or live activation from manual review or test activity.
steps.evidence: Unavailable-analysis/manual-review/controlled-roleplay/owner-gate trace.

positive: A newly provisioned tenant can resume a one-question setup, independently assign two salesperson lines, review intake manually and see exact remaining activation gates.
negative: A browser draft, upload preview, phone chip, manual review or roleplay cannot claim analysis, provider connection, customer send or production activation.

requiredEvidence: Tenant/role/source/connection denial and recovery traces with no raw-file/customer-history leakage.

journeys.title: Salesperson-scoped day to authorised output activity
journeys.actualRuntimeGap: An owner chip, browser filter, Sales count, local print request, native dialog or reprint link is not a current account grant, cross-cover authority, physical print receipt or customer delivery proof.

steps.action: Open Sales on the actor’s owned number and assigned-account scope with named filter and counts.
steps.permissions: Authenticated salesperson scope over current tenant line/accounts/orders.
steps.draft: The selected scoped filter restores only while current assignment remains valid.
steps.failure: Changed line/account assignment clears stale scope and returns to permitted results.
steps.customerOutcome: No access, count, message or document claim for unassigned accounts.
steps.evidence: Two-salesperson owned-line/account-filter/count fixture.

steps.action: Open a scoped order and return to the same Sales filter/count basis.
steps.permissions: Current account/order read authority.
steps.draft: Return context retains selected permitted IDs only.
steps.failure: Route, account, role or revision change invalidates stale return/output scope.
steps.customerOutcome: No unrelated customer/order exposure.
steps.evidence: Scoped-order return, revocation and stale-filter fixture.

steps.action: Review and request own-day document output from exact scoped frozen orders.
steps.permissions: Document/output authority for each selected current order revision.
steps.draft: Selected IDs/profile/paper/copies remain review intent until rendering request is accepted.
steps.failure: Mixed scope or changed revision blocks the request and retains a repairable selection.
steps.customerOutcome: No extra document, printed claim or customer delivery.
steps.evidence: Scoped-day output/frozen-revision/A4-A5/copies fixture.

steps.action: Record immutable print request/activity and handle retry or linked reprint.
steps.permissions: Output/print authority and current document scope.
steps.draft: Run key, artifact, requested actor/time and reprintOf linkage persist independently of live edits.
steps.failure: Popup block, dialog close, download or unknown outcome stays unconfirmed; same-attempt retry preserves identity.
steps.customerOutcome: No physical-print, delivery or receipt claim without acknowledgement/verified receipt.
steps.evidence: Popup-blocked retry, old-copy-after-edit, Previous request and immutable-activity fixture.

steps.action: Select named bounded cross-cover and recheck scope on expiry, revoke or reload.
steps.permissions: Manager-authorised coverage grant naming covering actor, covered line/accounts, time and reason.
steps.draft: Coverage proposal/audit reason persists without changing ownership.
steps.failure: Denied, expired or conflicted coverage exposes no target book and cannot self-widen scope.
steps.customerOutcome: No cross-cover message, print or customer access outside the accepted grant.
steps.evidence: Cross-cover grant/expiry/revoke/cross-tenant denial fixture.

positive: A salesperson sees only owned assigned work, produces immutable own-day activity and can use a manager-authorised bounded cross-cover scope.
negative: A default filter, owner chip, stale session, cross-cover proposal or browser print cannot widen access, alter ownership or claim physical delivery.

requiredEvidence: Two-salesperson scope/count/output/cross-cover/revocation trace with no unassigned-object exposure.
